quality_guards: Glass risk depends on product size, breakage potential, process temperature, machinery, handling method, layout, housekeeping and worker competence.
Glass-sector evidence is process-, material-, task-, exposure- and worker-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury or asthma probability.
Shipbuilding risk depends on vessel condition, task, access, hot work, gas inventory, enclosure, weather, lifting plan and contractor coordination.
Ship-repair evidence is vessel-, task-, space-, gas-, equipment- and workforce-specific and is not an exact parcel-level incident probability.
Production risk depends on location, set design, vehicles, stunts, pyrotechnics, weapons, weather, freelancers and schedule pressure.
Film and broadcasting evidence is production-, location-, activity-, contractor- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level incident probability.
Theatre risk depends on production design, rigging, scenery, load-in, performance effects, audience layout, competence and time pressure.
Theatre evidence is venue-, production-, task-, equipment-, audience- and schedule-specific and is not an exact parcel-level incident probability.
Veterinary-medicine risk depends on active ingredient, formulation, dose, applicator, animal behaviour, exposure route, frequency and worker susceptibility.
Veterinary-medicine evidence is product-, task-, animal-, exposure- and worker-specific and is not an exact parcel-level poisoning probability.
Zoonotic risk depends on organism, animal species, shedding, contact pattern, hygiene facilities, visitor behaviour and individual vulnerability.
Animal-contact evidence is organism-, animal-, setting-, contact- and person-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Specified-pathogen risk depends on agent, strain, quantity, procedure, containment level, equipment, personnel and emergency capability.
SAPO evidence is agent-, facility-, process-, containment- and incident-specific and is not an exact parcel-level release probability.
Play-inflatable risk depends on device design, wind, anchoring, pressure, surface, user mix, supervision, maintenance and emergency response.
Inflatable evidence is device-, site-, weather-, operator-, user- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Sealed-inflatable risk depends on pressure, construction, documentation, anchorage, wind, water, supervision, inspection and maintenance condition.
Sealed-inflatable evidence is device-, environment-, inspection-, operator- and user-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Event-electrical risk depends on supply type, load, earthing, weather, cable routes, protection, equipment condition, competence and public access.
Event-electrical evidence is venue-, installation-, equipment-, environment-, operator- and audience-specific and is not an exact parcel-level electrocution probability.
